notes.title: Episode 11 is Written!
notes.content:
[p]Hey guys![/p][p]I’m finally ready to start working on the visuals since the script for Episode 11 is finished!
Sooo, don’t even know where to start. This thing is gonna be huge… maybe too huge even by my standards, heh.[/p][p]The whole Episode 11 counts 89 pages of dialogue, packed with story scenes and an extremely ridiculous number of lewd moments with many of the ladies from the game. Some arc will continue, some will get a fresh start, and some will finally deliver that long-awaited progression.[/p][p]The pacing this time is much faster compared to Episode 10, which was more about showing the shi…storm MC got into. I’ve made sure the main story gets plenty of focus because SUaD really needs to start tying all the arcs together and steering toward the finale. Basically, you’re now choosing your allies for the final fight and deciding what you’re going to do with Jake at the end. And by choosing, I mean some very interesting encounters with different ladies… after all, we’re talking about AVN here, hehe.[/p][p]The main star of this episode is undoubtedly [b]Violet[/b], who reappeared at the end of the last update. This time MC has no way of escaping her. Violet wants him on her leash, and if he hopes to find Jake, he’ll need to run some errands for her. And those errands… well, to me that’s the most exciting part of the update.[/p][p]Next up: [b]Nora[/b], Charlie’s wife. MC is going to meet her, and you’ll decide whether to start her arc. She’s extremely vulnerable right now, and it’ll be up to you whether to help her or make her pay for what Charlie did. Her scenes mostly set things up for the next episode and her possible role in the endgame.[/p][p]Who else? [b]Faith[/b], of course! We’ll finally see what Jake did to her while trying to track him down. But first, MC has to restore her memories, and the way he does that might come with some consequences…[/p][p]Speaking of consequences. Your earlier choices matter too. If you’ve progressed with [b]Ange[/b] and [b]Ann[/b], both arcs will continue. Ann is still struggling with her marriage, but maybe some time with MC will finally make her happier. 
Ange? She’s the rebel who knows the full truth about MC and the mess he’s in… maybe she has some ideas on how to get out of it… and have fun along the way.[/p][p]And, sure thing, I can’t forget [b]Megan[/b] and [b]Sarah[/b]. These two will get their own scenes as well. They’re always there for MC and always make him feel welcome, even if they’re a little busy these days. ;-p[/p][p]That’s what I wanted to share for now. The script is very ambitious this time, it’s already bigger than 10.1 and 10.2 combined. I can already feel this giant ton of work smirking at me, but I still want to release it as one solid piece instead of splitting it into chapters. The good news is that I don’t have college anymore, so I can dedicate much more time to development. 
Right now it looks doable (if just a bit overwhelming, heh). But even in the worst case, if it drags on, I’ve made some logical breaks in the script where it could be split into two chapters. Don’t worry, it won’t be a 12-month wait.[/p][p]That’s it for now, guys. I’ll do one final pass for last touches and edits here and there, and then it’s time to start rendering this beast. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

She's important and she'll influence the story a lot in the future. (Oh, and she's also hot. ;-p) 

So, on the paper the main part of the update looks like 50% of fun and 50% of the story, but I also want to add two special scenes this time which will be available in the gallery and which won't interfere the main storyline. 
That's how it looks right now and that's what you can expect from the next update. :)

I've seen a lot of comments that MC should finish Jake as soon as possible but their story won't be finished till the very end of the game and we won't see Jake much till the final chapters. The reason is pretty simple - if we finish Jake's story right now, there won't be much sense in finishing other storylines... and we do have quite a few hotties who need our attention!
